source_text: Three randomized controlled trials conducted in Africa between 2005 and 2007 demonstrated that male circumcision reduces heterosexual HIV acquisition by 51% to 60% over 24 to 72 months of follow-up, with protective efficacy increasing over time due to cumulative exposure prevention.
